title: Mechanism conclusion

bodyBlocks.text: The natural sequence is shale erosion, loss of support, then sandstone breakaway. The packing profile is support withdrawal: intact seal, lower contact trace, cradle removed. Impact and water each fail the full observation set. The intact exterior therefore does not establish that the contents stayed in place.
Foundation-material note: SHALE. Keep this with the next dispatch protocol; it supplies the key, not a guessed password.
